Agent entry point

Source: AGENTS.md

Start at adocs/pattern-model-plan.md; it is the active plan. Historical phases and receipts are preserved under adocs/archive/. Then read only the owning source/help/tests for the requested operation. Do not replay completed phases or ask again about the accepted pattern_model name and in-package numerical core.

Resolve git rev-parse HEAD and current refs before making a branch claim. This revision inspected master at 7c93f8d. The older named feature branch did not resolve; no current branch name is authoritative merely because a note says so.

Use the existing model_spec / fit_roi / roi_result contracts and model$crossval. Global analysis has its own thin method. Matrix targets use model_targets, not CV labels. Regional payload retention and scalar searchlight outputs are distinct. No classifier-name special cases, private-class forging or runtime monkey patches.

Preserve original units, feature identities, fold-resolved/pooled ledgers and training-only transformations. Keep forward patterns, weights, conditional model information and independent confirmation separate. Never promote selected rank to significance or sparse coefficients to voxel p-values.

For crossform, follow the versioned optional adapter contract linked from the plan. Proposed protocol verbs are not installed R functions. Missing residuals, retention or ancestry cause explicit limited capability/refusal, not invention.

Use adocs/pattern-model-benchmarks.md before optimizing: weak/dense signal and sparsity, local covariance and CR1 each have scoped recorded limitations. A stale benchmark is not a universal recommendation or a new successful test run.

Run scoped tests in an isolated library for code changes; preserve ITEM’s fmrilss delegation and the archived hrfdecoder boundary. Never install into the user’s library or alter evaluation thresholds without explicit authorization. End with exact changes, observed checks, unrun checks and the smallest valid next action.
